statements.impact_statement: CVE-2024-46742 affects the Linux kernel SMB server smb2_open implementation, not userspace UAPI declarations: https://ubuntu.com/security/CVE-2024-46742 . This statement applies only to the exact Ubuntu userspace development-header package, whose inventory contains non-executable UAPI headers and documentation and no SMB server implementation. Every Worker build and native candidate smoke check verifies that inventory and rejects kernel image/module/header packages. Vendor inventories: https://packages.ubuntu.com/noble-updates/amd64/linux-libc-dev/filelist and https://packages.ubuntu.com/noble-updates/arm64/linux-libc-dev/filelist . The deployment host kernel is NOT assessed by this statement and must receive its own security updates. New CVEs and other package versions are not covered.
